svg.title: How IBM Confluent works: connect, process, govern
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Connect: 150 pre-built connectors for databases, SaaS apps, on-premises systems and cloud services. Process: fully managed Apache Flink processes the streams in real time. Govern: built-in governance and data quality tools, and Tableflow turns streams into open tables for a data lake.
